meta.title: About us | AZAFCO International, Egyptian fish since 2008
meta.description: Founded in 2008, AZAFCO International farms, sources, packs and exports fresh Egyptian fish to 7+ markets, with 2,500 t/month packing capacity.

hero.title: Egyptian fish, handled by us from the pond to the pallet
hero.intro: Founded in 2008, we farm and source fish in Egypt, then inspect, pack and export it fresh to importers, distributors and foodservice buyers across the Middle East and beyond.
hero.reassure: Start with a message: species, quantity and destination. Prices confirmed per order.
hero.image_alt: Two workers pulling a seine net full of fish to the bank of an earthen pond

story.title: Built on fish since 2008
story.p1: We were founded in 2008. Our first export market for fresh fish was the UAE in 2008, followed by Kuwait in 2009, Bahrain in 2012, Lebanon in 2015, Qatar in 2024, Iraq in 2025 and Syria in 2026.
story.p2: Today we ship by air and road to 7+ markets, with Europe next in our plan. Fish remains our core business; under the AZAFCO International identity it sits alongside our agriculture, livestock and investment activities.

operations.title: Every stage is handled by AZAFCO
operations.intro: We farm and source the fish, prepare it at our own plant and move it in our own refrigerated trucks, so you deal with one company from the pond to the pallet.
operations.s1_text: We farm our own fish and also buy from other producers. All of it is washed, graded and inspected at our own plant.
operations.s2_text: The fish is harvested and taken to our plant in Motobas, Kafr El Sheikh.
operations.s3_text: Washed, iced, graded by weight and packed whole on ice.
operations.s4_text: Checked against the agreed specification before the boxes are closed.
operations.s5_text: Our own refrigerated trucks, then air or road freight.

businesses.title: Fish at the core, with other activities alongside
businesses.p1: Farming, sourcing, packing and exporting fresh fish is our core business and the focus of this website.
businesses.p2: AZAFCO International also works in agriculture, livestock and investment.
businesses.image_alt: Whole fresh fish on crushed ice seen from above

footprint.title: Our plant, trucks and cold stores
footprint.p1: Our fish processing and packing plant is in the Industrial Zone of Motobas, Kafr El Sheikh, in Egypt's Nile Delta. Here the fish is received, washed, iced, graded and packed, then loaded for dispatch.
footprint.p2: We run our own refrigerated trucks, cold stores and logistics, from the plant to air or road freight.
footprint.image_alt: Whole fresh fish on crushed ice in white insulated boxes in a packing hall
footprint.map_link: See the plant on Google Maps

values.title: We start with specifications, not slogans
values.intro: The principles behind how we work with buyers.
values.i1_text: We have exported fresh fish since 2008, and our first markets, the UAE and Kuwait, are still active today.
values.i2_text: We start from what you need (species, weight grade, packing, quantity and destination), then confirm what we can supply.
values.i3_text: Specifications, documents and commercial terms are set out clearly and confirmed per order.
values.i4_text: We aim for repeat supply built on consistency, not one-off deals.

direction.title: Vision and mission
direction.vision_text: To be a trusted Egyptian partner in production and supply for regional and international markets, through business built on quality, clarity and lasting relationships.
direction.mission_text: To supply products and services that fit the needs of our business partners, connecting production and processing in Egypt with the requirements of the markets we serve.
direction.identity_text: AZAFCO International keeps the AZAFCO name and its heritage, in a form that matches our work with partners and importers in the Middle East and beyond.
